Think critically about the world, solve problems using appropriate analytic skills, and be discerning about the quality of information to identify and examine real-world examples of concepts explored in coursework and their implications for watershed management.
Communicate effectively across levels and disciplines utilizing a variety of methods and mediums on the subject of watershed management.

programs.title: Welding Technology
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units
outcomes: Demonstrate an understanding of welding safety.
Demonstrate various welding procedures to the standards set by the American Welding Society.

programs.title: Wildland Fire
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: Meet minimum qualifications for entry level positions with organizations or agencies engaged with wildland fire operations.
Reach proficiency with wildland firefighting skills. This is measured by a field taskbook.
Obtain knowledge to interpret seasonal changes in the wildfire environment.
